segments.text: Hi everyone, welcome back.
Today we are painting a relaxing sunset over a lake.
This is a really easy one,
so grab your brushes and paint along with me.
I'm using a square canvas and some acrylic paints.
First, let's start with the sky.
I'm taking some yellow and putting it right here in the middle.
Just like that. Now some orange around it.
And a little bit of red at the top.
Blend, blend, blend. Very nice. Just keep blending.
You want it nice and smooth. Okay.
Now some purple at the very top. Blend that in.
Beautiful. Look at those colours. So relaxing. Okay, now for the sun.
I'm just going to take some white with
a little yellow and make a circle. Right there.
You can put your sun wherever you like. Now the mountains.
I'm mixing some blue and purple.
And we're just going to paint the mountains across here.
Up and down. Up and down. Just like that.
Mountains are very easy. You can't really make a mistake with mountains.
Now a lighter colour for the mountains in front.
Same thing. Up and down. Nice. Now the water.
For the water, I'm just using the same colours as the sky,
but upside down. So yellow in the middle, then orange, then red.
Horizontal strokes. Just go back and forth. Very relaxing.
Okay. Now some reflections.
I'm taking a little bit of white and doing some lines in the water.
Just little lines. Like that. Beautiful. Okay, now the trees.
I'm using black for the trees, because they're a silhouette.
Just tap tap tap with the brush. Tap tap tap.
And make the trunk. One more tree here.
And maybe one over here. Tap tap tap. Lovely.
Now some grass at the bottom. Flick flick flick.
Just flicking up with the brush. Okay.
And finally, let's add some birds.
Just little check marks in the sky. One, two, three.
And that's it! A beautiful relaxing sunset over a lake.
I hope you enjoyed painting with me today. If you did,
please give it a thumbs up and subscribe for more relaxing paintings.
See you next time. Bye bye.
